# Sources and integration status

- **Luxury_Editor_App_Shell**: actual live visual shell. Index, base layout, channels, two-pane writing, planner, editor controls, local storage, font uploads and keyboard.
- **LiteraryFriend_REPAIRED_Part2**: browser writing/continuity utilities, archival project documents/assets, supporting JSON data, book formats and styling; subset integrated into Helper.
- **writer_helper_ready.zip**: all supplied Helper JS modules preserved under `script/js/helper/`, with former ai-brain naming changed to Helper. The active browser uses local-only diagnostics; provider generation is disabled and large corpora do not load at startup.
- **fontforge-master.zip**: included as source/reference snapshot without Python scripting files. Integrated browser-facing vector glyph drawing and export tools; a complete compiled FontForge editor is NOT claimed.
- **wordcraft / Word-Clone / MS-word / ms-word-clone-v1**: source/reference snapshots included under `assets/`; browser editing, styling and import/export are integrated through the actual live Luxury Editor shell rather than starting native projects.
- **LiteraryFriend(2).gs**: analyzed solely to match request names, authentication and bridge messaging. It is NOT included in the distribution, modified, or redeployed.

The large number of reference assets is not a claim that every desktop-only third-party subsystem executes in the browser. The active app is intentionally self-contained, static and local-first.
